title: Capacity-Constrained Online Convex Optimization with Delayed Feedback
title_zh: 容量受限且反馈延迟的在线凸优化
abstract_en: Online learning with delayed feedback typically assumes that the learner can track all pending rounds until their feedback arrives. In practice, tracking resources are finite, and feedback from untracked rounds is permanently lost. In this paper, we study delayed online convex optimization (OCO) under a hard capacity constraint, where at most $C$ pending rounds can be tracked at any time. To model delay information, we introduce a semi-clairvoyant model that refines the clairvoyant assumption from prior work: rather than requiring delays to be known at prediction time, the learner observes delay expirations online, consistent with the classical unconstrained delayed setting. Our approach proceeds via a reduction to a novel ``delayed and weighted'' OCO problem, using a scheduler that randomizes tracking decisions and importance-weights the resulting observations. For this base problem, we propose and analyze Delayed-Weighted FTRL and its bandit analogue, establishing regret bounds that explicitly characterize the interaction between time-varying weights and delayed feedback. Combining these base learners with our schedulers yields the first regret guarantees for capacity-constrained OCO under convex and strongly convex losses, for both first-order and bandit feedback. For first-order feedback, capacity $C = Ω(\log T)$ suffices to recover standard delayed OCO rates up to logarithmic factors. For bandit feedback, the regret rates are modulated by powers of $(1 + σ_{\text{max}}/C)$, where $σ_{\text{max}}$ is the maximum number of pending observations at any time. This allows the regret bound to degrade gracefully when $C < σ_{\text{max}}$, while remaining sublinear.
abstract_zh: 本文研究在硬容量约束下的延迟在线凸优化（delayed OCO）：学习器任意时刻最多只能跟踪 C 个尚未返回反馈的轮次，未被跟踪轮次的反馈将永久丢失。作者提出一种半先知（semi-clairvoyant）模型来刻画延迟信息：不同于以往要求预测时已知延迟的 clairvoyant 假设，该模型只要求学习器在线观察延迟到期事件，更接近经典无容量约束的延迟反馈设定。方法上，论文将问题规约为新的“延迟加权”在线凸优化问题，通过调度器随机决定跟踪哪些轮次，并对观测反馈进行重要性加权。针对该基础问题，作者提出 Delayed-Weighted FTRL 及其 bandit 版本，给出显式刻画时变权重与延迟反馈相互作用的 regret 上界。结合调度器后，论文首次为容量受限 OCO 在凸损失与强凸损失、一阶反馈与 bandit 反馈下建立 regret 保证。结果表明，一阶反馈中容量 C = Ω(log T) 即可在对数因子内恢复标准 delayed OCO 速率；bandit 反馈中 regret 会随 (1 + σ_max/C) 的幂次变化，其中 σ_max 表示任意时刻最大待处理观测数，从而在 C < σ_max 时也能平滑退化并保持次线性 regret。
key_points_zh: 提出容量受限 delayed OCO：学习器最多同时跟踪 C 个 pending rounds，未跟踪轮次的反馈永久丢失，更贴近资源受限场景。
引入 semi-clairvoyant 延迟模型：学习器在线观察反馈到期，而非预测时预知延迟，弱化并细化既有 clairvoyant 假设。
将原问题规约为 delayed and weighted OCO，通过随机调度器选择跟踪轮次，并用 importance weighting 修正由抽样造成的偏差。
提出并分析 Delayed-Weighted FTRL 及 bandit analogue，给出同时依赖时变权重与延迟结构的 regret 上界。
证明在一阶反馈下 C = Ω(log T) 可基本恢复标准 delayed OCO 速率；在 bandit 反馈下 regret 随 (1 + σ_max/C) 平滑退化，容量不足时仍可保持次线性。

llm_assessment.comment: A solid online-learning theory paper, but it has little direct relevance to agent harness architecture or production agent evolution.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 这是一篇扎实的在线学习理论论文，但与智能体运行框架或生产级自进化平台关系很弱。
